counter.name: GAME_DIFFICULTY_COUNTER
counter.representation: one ASCII digit, initialized from GAME_DIFFICULTY_MODE and clamped to '9'

behavior: Increments the byte and clamps it at ASCII '9'.
Queues audio command 0x66 with the updated value when SCENE_VDP_UPDATE_FLAG is set.

corrections: The Type-0x46 level-event gates compare GAME_DIFFICULTY_COUNTER with ASCII '9'; they are not scene/mode values.
The selector-0xAF gate has the same ASCII-'9' cap test.
limitations: The static closure does not identify the user-facing resource represented by the displayed digit.
Runtime promotion is intentionally not claimed because the current coverage corpus does not contain the increment call sites.
conclusion: The direct GAME_DIFFICULTY_COUNTER reader/writer family and all four known increment-service callers are now recorded as one closed static contract, while its conservative canonical name is retained.
